Definition: of Hebrew origin (H8289); Saron (i.e. Sharon), a district of Palestine:--Saron.
BiblicalUsage: Saron is the district beside Lydda where the healing of Aeneas was seen: all that dwelt at Lydda and Saron saw him, and turned to the Lord. The Greek text behind the King James Version spells the name with the accent on the first syllable, while the text I have checked spells it with the accent on the last.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a whole district turning is the point — one man's healing became a whole region's turning, because they saw him and knew the Lord had done it.
